description: RCS on the brand's own Twilio account: which RCS senders its Messaging Services hold, whether it can send RCS yet, the ordered setup steps (Twilio creates and carriers approve a sender only in the Twilio Console, about 4 to 6 weeks), the inbound webhook URL, and, with profile, a check of the sender profile (logo 224x224 under 50 kB, banner 1440x448 under 200 kB, accent colour contrast, links) against Twilio's rules. messagingServiceSid saves the default service for send_sms channel "rcs". Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
